_notes: Floor-only baseline. The CI mutation workflow has two gates: (a) regression
catch — fails if any module's killed count drops below the per-module 'killed'
value below, and (b) strict-100% — fails if any mutant survives. Post-Phase-4.2
we expect 0 survivors per module, so gate (b) is the binding check.
Phase 4.2 added 13 strengthening tests against the 33 remaining Linux-CI
survivors (22 in tdm_validation, 11 in knowledge_loaders) plus 7 # pragma:
no mutate annotations for genuine equivalent mutants (4 sort_keys variants
in load_rules, 2 FreshnessMetadata default-value kwargs in assess_freshness,
1 _lowest_confidence rank-dict magnitude). PR #32 separately removed
sumo_qa_load_specialty_tools (9 mutants) from knowledge_loaders' total.
Survivor-mutant-name lists were dropped — they are stale across source
refactors and the workflow only reads 'killed'.
